rules.contract: The client preserves governed proper names, supporter-authored identities, and official football identities as supplied; these values are not UI chrome translations.
rules.rationale: Names and official football identities must not be machine-translated or silently rewritten by the client.

rules.contract: Published editorial and catalog copy must be English. Preserve proper names and source facts; the client must not invent a translation or substitute a record.
rules.rationale: The mobile client renders governed editorial records and must not claim that arbitrary remote copy is translated merely because the surrounding interface is localized.

rules.contract: Controlled categories, labels, and positions are mapped to localized client copy when they act as UI chrome; source-authored values remain governed content.
rules.rationale: These fields cross a mixed enum/content boundary and require an explicit client mapping or source-locale treatment instead of an implicit translation claim.

rules.contract: Typed service outcomes are mapped to core_l10n copy before supporter display; unrecognized backend diagnostics remain private or use a localized generic fallback.
rules.rationale: Backend message text is diagnostic data, not a trusted localization source of truth.

rules.contract: Only active English runtime copy is displayed. Retired locale rows are removed by the English-only migration.
rules.rationale: The runtime-copy registry is the explicit dynamic localization channel.
